props.caption: Kraków. Prosecutors have opened a terrorism inquiry but say motive and ideology remain unresolved.
Nvidia. Independent directors and outside counsel will oversee the board’s inquiry.
Riyadh. Air defences intercepted and destroyed two ballistic missiles; shrapnel caused minor damage to an Aramco building.

lead.what: Prosecutors have formally opened a terrorism inquiry into the Kraków shooting, while saying motive and ideology remain unresolved.

rest.what: Nvidia’s board named independent directors and outside counsel to examine reports involving Jensen Huang.

lead.what: Labour leads the preliminary party vote while National holds more seats; special votes leave New Zealand’s next government unsettled.

rest.what: Hakeem Jeffries endorsed a planned privileged resolution to impeach Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth.

lead.what: Falling shrapnel caused minor damage to an administrative Aramco building in Riyadh, with no injuries or fatalities reported.
